bgꜣ — failing, harm, damage (?) (noun; written with the bird of bad things; the sense follows the classifier and the context; Budge: beḳa, 'defect') — w26
rmi — to weep (verb; written with the weeping eye) — w39
psg — to spit, spit on (verb; written with the man with hand to mouth; the reading is not sure; Budge: pesaḳ, 'wash') — w47
ḫpdt — hindquarters, rump (?) (noun f.; the reading and sense follow Budge's χepṭet and are not sure) — w55
mḥt-wrt — Mehet-weret, 'the Great Flood', the sky as a cow in the waters, mother of the sun (goddess's name; Budge: Meḥ-urt) — w57, w83
ṯs-pẖr — and vice versa, conversely (phrase; ṯs 'tie' + pẖr 'turn round'; closes a statement that holds both ways; Budge: θes rer) — w60+w61
nwy — water, flood, the waters (noun; written with the pot nw and water classifiers; Budge: ennui) — w67
twt — image, statue, likeness (noun m.) — w72
imsty — Imsety, one of the four sons of Horus, who guard the dead man's inner organs (god's name; also written msṯi; Budge: Mesthà) — w111, w175, w240
ḥpy — Hapy, one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; not the Nile flood ḥꜥpy; Budge: Ḥāpi) — w112, w176, w241
dwꜣ-mwt-f — Duamutef, 'He who adores his mother', one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; Budge: Ṭuamāutef) — w113, w177, w242
qbḥ-snw-f — Qebehsenuf, 'He who refreshes his brothers', one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; Budge: Qebḥsennuf) — w114, w178, w243
ḥtp-sḫws — Hetep-sekhus, a fiery goddess, the Eye of Ra (goddess's name; the meaning of the name is not clear; Budge: Ḥetep-sekhus) — w127, w194, w200
sfḫ — seven (numeral) — w140, w239, w266
spꜣ — Sepa, a god written with the centipede (god's name; Budge: Sepa) — w146
isds — Isdes, a god of the judgement of the dead, named with Thoth (god's name; Budge: Àsṭes) — w168
m-sꜣ — behind, after (compound preposition: m 'in' + sꜣ 'back') — w182, w257+w258
ḫpš — foreleg, thigh (of an ox) (noun m.); the Foreleg, the constellation of the Great Bear in the northern sky (Budge: χepeś, 'the Thigh') — w184
sꜣm — to burn (verb; written with the flame; sꜣmt, the infinitive or a noun 'burning'; Budge: samt) — w212
mꜣꜣ-itf-f — Maa-itef-ef, 'He who sees his father', one of the seven spirits (god's name; Budge: Maa-atef-f) — w244
ẖry-bꜣq-f — Khery-baqef, 'He who is under his moringa tree', one of the seven spirits (god's name; Budge: Kheri-beq-f) — w245
ḥr-ḫnty-irty — Horus-Khenty-irty, 'Horus Foremost of the Two Eyes', a form of Horus (god's name; Budge: Ḥeru-khenti-maa) — w246
nḏḥ-nḏḥ — Nedjeh-nedjeh, one of the seven spirits (god's name; meaning not clear; Budge: Net'eḥ-net'eḥ) — w268
iꜣqd-qd — Iaqed-qed, one of the seven spirits (god's name; meaning not clear; reading doubtful; Budge: Àaqeṭqeṭ) — w269
in-rdi-n-f-bs-f-ḫnty-hh-f — In-redi-nef-besef-khenty-hehef, one of the seven spirits; the name holds rdi 'give', bs 'flame', ḫnty 'foremost' and hh 'heat' (?), its sense not clear (god's name; first sign unidentified; Budge: Àn-erṭā-nef-bes-f-khenti-heh-f) — w270
ꜥq-ḥr-imy-wnwt-f — Aq-her-imy-unutef, one of the seven spirits; the name holds ꜥq 'enter', ḥr 'face', imy 'who is in' and wnwt 'hour', its sense not clear (god's name; Budge: Āq-ḥer-àmmi-unnut-f) — w271
dšr-irty-imy-ḥwt-ins — Desher-irty-imy-hut-ines, 'Red of eyes, who is in the house of red linen' (?), one of the seven spirits (god's name; reading doubtful; Budge: Ṭesher-maa-àmmi-ḥet-Ànes) — w272
wbs-ḥr-pr-m-ḫtḫt — Webes-her-per-em-khetkhet, one of the seven spirits; ḥr 'face', pr 'who comes forth' and m ḫtḫt 'backwards' (?) are clear, wbs is not (god's name; Budge: Ubes-ḥrà-per-em-khetkhet) — w273
mꜣꜣ-m-grḥ-in-n-f-m-hrw — Maa-em-gereh-in-nef-em-heru, 'He who sees by night and brings by day' (?), one of the seven spirits (god's name; reading doubtful; Budge: Maa-em-ḳerḥ-àn-nef-em-hru) — w274
irwd — a word written with the house classifier, a building or place, not identified (noun; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: àruṭ, 'hall') — w281
pf — that (masculine demonstrative, after its noun; fem. tf) — w289
ṯꜣfy — the Two Tjafi (?), a pair of gods (dual name; reading uncertain; Budge: T'afi, 'the two Tchafi') — w310
BROADEN hꜣb — a second word of the same spelling: to send, send out (verb; Budge: habi, 'made to depart') — w13
BROADEN mr — a second word of the same spelling: to be ill, sick; sickness (verb, noun; written with the hoe mr and the bird of bad things) — w35
BROADEN sn — a second word of the same spelling: brother; companion, fellow (noun m.; written with the arrowhead sn) — w41
BROADEN wḏꜣ — also the noun 'soundness, well-being' (noun m.) — w58, w59
BROADEN nn — the demonstrative also written nnw, with the pot nw and w, and standing first in a sentence without a verb, 'this is …' (later spelling) — w66, w97, w136
BROADEN mk — also written m·tn, mtn 'behold', when more than one person is addressed (particle with the suffix ·tn) — w128
BROADEN wꜥb — also wꜥbt 'the pure place', the place of embalming (noun f.; written with the house) — w259
